title: SII Vol. 19 No. 421
location_detail: On the same wall
summary: This records a gift of 7 kalanju of gold for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple of Perumanadigal at Tirunalakkunram in Kunriyur-nadu by (a lady) Udaiyan Kalimadi on behalf of her (deceased?) son Vilupperaiyar Velan Pugalan of Mannaikudi

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 424
location_detail: On the same wall
summary: It records a gift of nine Ilakkasu by the urar of Tirukkamanjur in Kalakkudi-nadu for burning a lamp with an uri of ghee every day in the temple

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 425
location_detail: On the same wall
summary: This is also in Vatteluttu script and is much damaged

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 426 — Tiruchchengodu
location_detail: On the rock to the east of the steps called Arupadam padi on the hill
summary: This records a gift of 5 kalnju of gold deposited with the Tiruvadirai-Ganapperumakkal (committee) at Tiruchchengodu for feeding with the interest thereon five Brahmanas (on the day of Tiruvadirai every month), by Kadan Pudi Maikkam in the name of his daughter Mundankon

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 427
location_detail: On the same rock
summary: It seems to record an endowment made by [Ku]kari Sundari wife of a native of Pugaliyur for feeding Brahmanas on the days of dvadasi through the agency of Dvadasi-Ganapperumakkal at Tiruchchengodu

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 428 — Kuttalam
location_detail: On the east wall of the first prakara, Kuttalanathasvami temple
summary: It records a gift of 25 sheep for burning a lamp with an ulakku of ghee every day in the temple of Mahadeva at Tirukkurralam by one Nakkan Appi Tirumurtti

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 429 — Tiruchchengodu
location_detail: On the rock to the east of the steps known as Arupadampadi on the hill
summary: This records a gift of 12 kalanju of gold deposited with the (assembly) Pannirandu-nattu-perumakkal of Tiruchchengodu by Vedan Sendan Seruvachchi for burning a lamp in the temple with the interest thereon

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 430
location_detail: In the same place
summary: This records a gift of 3 kalanju of gold for feeding with its interest 2 Brahmanas on the days of dvadasi, Tiruvadirai and Turvonam every month (in the temple) on the hill at Tiruchchengodu, through the agency of the three respective(?) Ganapperumakkal of th place

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 431 — Kumbhakonam
location_detail: On the west and south walls of the central shrine, Nagesvara temple
date_text: This may be assigned to Parantaka I on account of the early writing and the high regnal year given for the king
summary: It is bilingual and records a gift of 20 gold coins to the temple of Tirukkilkottattu-Bhattaraka by Kachchuvan (Kasyapan) Danapati Arangan alias Panchavan . . . . the headman of Karuvur in Milalaik-kurram

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 432 — Tiruvengavasal
location_detail: On the north wall of the mandapa in front of the central shrine, Vyaghrapurisvara temple
summary: This is unfinished, and seems to record some provision made in money for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple of Tirumerrali-Mahadeva at [Tiruvengai]vayil in Peruvayil-nadu by a native of Kalaimangalam in Kaviram (Kavira-nadu) a division of Valla-nadu

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 433 — Tiruchchattutai
location_detail: On the west and south walls of the central shrine, Odanavanesvara temple
summary: It records a gift of 30 kalanju of gold for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple of Tiruchchorrutturai-Mahadeva with an ulakku [of ghee] every day to be supplied by the patipadamulattar

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 434 — Graman
location_detail: On the south wall of the central shrine, Sivalokanatha temple
summary: This is built in at the beginning and is also incomplete

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 435 — Tirugokarnam
location_detail: On the third pillar (from the right) in front of the rock-cut central shrine, Gokarnesvara temple
summary: It seems to record a gift, by Peruman Vamanan of Tiruvetpur in Kavira-nadu a subdivision of Valla-nadu, of one tulaippon (kalanju) with the annual interest on which an offering was to be made to god Gokarnattu-Mahadeva, on the day of Uttiram evidently in Panguni month

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 437 — Tiruchchatturai
location_detail: On the south wall of the central shrine, Odanavanesvara temple
summary: It records a gift of sheep by a certain Lokamarayan for a perpetual lamp to be burnt in the temple with an ulakku of ghee every day supplied by a local shepherd

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 438 — Somur
location_detail: On the south wall of the mandapa in front of the central shrine, Somesvaram-Udaiyar temple
summary: It records a gift of 5 kalanju of gold by the standard weight) kasettangal for burning a lamp during the day in the temple of Mahadeva at Tirunombalur by Araiyan Kaman a resident of Sirrur in Miyamala-nadu

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 439 — Kuttalam
location_detail: On the east wall of the prakara, Kuttalanathasvami temple
summary: This is in Vatteluttu and records a gift of 6 buffaloes for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple at Tirukkurralam in Tenvari-naru by Kovadi Konra Vellala resident of Vallapuram in Mala-nadu

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 440 — Sinnamanur
location_detail: On the north wall of the Lakshminarayana-Perumal temple
date_text: This is dated in the 36th year of Parakesarivarmn and is engraved in the Vatteluttu alphabet
summary: It is much damaged and is also incomplete

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 441 — Tiruchchengodu
location_detail: On the rock to the east of the steps called Arupadamapadi on the hill
date_text: This is mutilated fragment of an inscription stopping with the regnal year of the king, who might be very possibly Parantaka I
summary: Kudumiyamalai, Pudukkottai state, Tiruchirapalli District

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 443
location_detail: On the south and east faces of the same pillar
summary: This records a gift of 7 tulaippon of gold for a perpetual lamp in the temple of Perumanadigal at Tirunalakkunram in Kunriyur-nadu by Poduva . . . . . Echehil Mandai a resident of Parunkurrakkudi in the same nadu, who deposited the amount with four temple servants (pattudaiyar) for the purpose

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 444 — Tiruvellarai
location_detail: On the rock in front of the Siva temple
summary: It seems to record a gift of (30) kalanju of gold deposited with the mula-parishad of Tiruvellarai by a local resident for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple See

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 202
location_detail: above, with which this is identical

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 445 — Tirumalpuram
location_detail: On the north wall of the central shrine, ruined Vishnu Temple
summary: This records a gift of 120 sheep for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple of Perumanadigal at Govindapadi in Valla-nadu a division of Damar-kottam, by Panchavan-Mahadeviyar, who is stated to be the consort Solapperumanadigal and to have hailed from Kottur in Nenmail-nadu a division of Sola-nadu

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 446
location_detail: On the same wall
summary: This records a gift of 96 sheep for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple of Ninraliya-Perumanadigal at Govindapadi by one Kuditangi Ulagatali of Tavusampalalai in Damar-kottam
